headline: Iraq resumes crude pumping through original pipeline to Turkiye after 12 years
summary: Iraq resumed pumping crude oil through its original pipeline to Turkiye on Nov. 17 at an initial rate of 120,000 barrels per day, ending a 12-year shutdown, the Oil Ministry announced.
why: The pipeline provides an alternative export route for northern and central Iraqi crude to Mediterranean ports, bypassing the Strait of Hormuz.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Restarting the pipeline introduces 120,000 bpd of supply flow directly to the Mediterranean.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
